To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the adoption of PHR platforms by consumers can lead to the adoption of EHRs by competing health care providers and that the adoption of E HRs by competing health providers can lead to the creation of a 'national health record network.'

(1) a PHR platform can create incentives for health care providers to share their EHR systems; (2) a PHR can increase consumer surplus by reducing the cost of sharing records; (3) the PHR platform can also increase the cost of sharing by increasing the switching cost; and (4) a PHR system can create a 'national health network' by providing a platform for the exchange of health records.

a personal health record platform, by selectively subsidiz-ing the health care providers and creating a proxy for a national health information network, can create incentives to share patients' electronic records among health care providers.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the adoption of electronic health records and the sharing of such records across providers.
the adoption of EHRs and how PHR platforms can facilitate this adoption.
the adoption of EHR and the sharing of EHR among health care providers, which is a critical step in achieving a national health information network in the United States.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
a health record platform can provide a means for a national health information network, where consumers can freely exchange health records among competing health care providers.
an online PHR can create a 'national health network' by providing a common platform for the sharing of EHR among providers.
a personal health record platform can create a 'national health record network' that would increase consumer surplus and improve health care efficiency.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the adoption of PHRs is likely to increase health care providers' adoption of EHRs.
a well-designed PHR platform can help facilitate the adoption of EHR systems and improve the sharing of health records in the United States.
the adoption of PHR platforms can be used to increase the sharing of EHRs and thus increase consumer surplus.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the adoption of a personal health records system may have the unintended effect of reducing the sharing of electronic health information.
a personal health record platform can be a catalyst for the adoption and sharing electronic health records.
a PHR platform, which is a private entity, can provide incentives for the adoption of an EHR system, which is a public good, by health care providers.
